product.name: Velora ComfortSection 3‑Seater
product.description: The Velora ComfortSection 3‑Seater is a modular sectional designed for modern living spaces. Its low‑profile frame is constructed from engineered wood and reinforced with steel rods, while the upholstery is a durable microfiber blend in a muted charcoal tone. The sofa measures 240 cm in length, 95 cm in depth, and 85 cm in height, providing ample seating for three adults. A hidden storage compartment under the back cushions offers convenient space for blankets or remote controls. The unit is easy to assemble with a quick‑connect system and can be reconfigured into a loveseat or a single chair as needed.
